rules.statement: A Court of Requests has jurisdiction to hear and determine an action for enforcing a contract if the 'contract sought to be enforced was made' within the local limits of its jurisdiction.
rules.supporting_quote: "The omission of paragraph (d) in section 77 of the Courts Ordinance, as amended by Ordinance No. 11 of 1895, was intentional. The cause of action is the non payment- of the wages, and that took place at Kalutara."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 77 of the Courts Ordinance, No. 1 of 1889, as amended by section 4 of the Ordinance No. 12 of 1895, and Section 9 of the Civil Procedure Code.
